# Generated Files

TKM generates runtime configuration from repository source.

| Path | Generator | TKM-owned content |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.termux/termux.properties` | `properties.py` | `extra-keys` setting |
| `~/.termux/helpers.sh` | `helpers.py` | Entire generated file |
| `~/.bashrc` | `helpers.py` | Marked TKM block |
| `~/.tmux.conf` | `tmux.py` | Marked TKM block |

## .bashrc

TKM uses these markers:

    # >>> termux-key-manager history >>>
    # <<< termux-key-manager history <<<

The generated block contains the TKM `HISTIGNORE` export and helper import.

The `HISTIGNORE` value is generated from every shell command declared in `macros.jsonc`, including:

- top-level `shell` fields
- `actions[].shell` entries
- shell commands in nested popup definitions

Actions of type `tmux` or `macro` are not included because they do not execute Bash commands.

Clipboard functions are not generated in `helpers.sh`. Copy keys are tmux actions routed to the repository's `copy_executor.py`; the old `cpy_*` helper names remain only in regression assertions and historical notes.

Content outside the block belongs to the user.

## .tmux.conf

TKM uses:

    # >>> termux-key-manager tmux >>>
    # <<< termux-key-manager tmux <<<

Only this block is TKM-owned.

## Copy runtime modules

`copy_executor.py` and `copy_selector.py` are repository source files called by tmux bindings. They are not generated runtime configuration files.

## termux.properties

TKM identifies the existing `extra-keys =` property and removes its multiline value before writing the generated setting.

Other properties remain.

## helpers.sh

The entire file is generated by TKM. It is not a hand-maintained source file.

## Source versus output

`macros.jsonc` is the source of truth.

Generated files are compiled runtime outputs. Permanent behavior changes belong in repository source or generator code, not in generated files.

## Preservation rule

When a file contains both user configuration and TKM configuration, TKM must preserve content outside its owned section.
